rules.logic: Fires when abioc `Unusual exec into a Kubernetes Pod` and abioc `A Kubernetes service account executed an unusual API call` both observe activity attributable to the same service-account principal (user.username) within a 15-minute window, stitching the interactive-exec foothold and the follow-on RBAC-write escalation into one Kubernetes intrusion incident.
rules.name: SIM-CDR-025 Exec Then Unusual SA API Correlation
